# WordToImage

> Free AI image generator that turns text prompts into high-quality images in seconds. 50+ styles, 4K output, commercial use included.

WordToImage is a web app for creating AI-generated images from natural-language descriptions. It supports multiple model providers, batch generation, social-media format presets, AI enhancement (upscaling, denoising, background removal), and converter tools (PDF ↔ JPG, Word ↔ JPG).

## Pages

- [Home](/): Overview of the AI image generator with examples and CTAs.
- [Text to Image](/text-to-image): Main generation tool — prompt-to-image with style controls.
- [Features](/features): Full feature list including styles, resolutions, and commercial rights.
- [Pricing](/pricing): Free and Pro plans with credit allocations.
- [Style Gallery](/style-gallery): 36 curated style presets across 6 categories.
- [Templates](/templates): Ready-to-use AI image templates for social and marketing.
- [Batch Generator](/batch-generator): Generate multiple images at once.
- [Tools](/tools): Hub for converters and enhancement utilities.
- [AI Enhance](/ai-enhance): Upscale, denoise, and clean up images.
- [AI Upscaler](/ai-upscaler): High-quality image upscaling.
- [Remove Background](/remove-background): One-click background removal.
- [PDF to JPG](/pdf-to-jpg): Convert PDF pages to JPG images.
- [JPG to PDF](/jpg-to-pdf): Convert JPG images to PDF documents.
- [Word to JPG](/word-to-jpg): Convert Word documents to JPG.
- [JPG to Word](/jpg-to-word): Extract text from JPG into Word.
- [Gallery](/gallery): Public examples of AI-generated images.
- [Community](/community): User showcase and prompts.
